statement_en:
Consider the probability space $([0,1],\mathcal{B}([0,1]),m)$, where $m$ is Lebesgue measure. Define the Bernoulli$(p)$ random variable
$$Y_2(\omega):=\begin{cases}0& 1\geq \omega >p\\ 1& p\geq \omega \geq 0 \end{cases}$$
Then its pushforward measure satisfies
$$P_{Y_2}(\{0\})=m((p,1])=1-p,\qquad P_{Y_2}(\{1\})=m([0,p])=p.$$
